name: 張福來
learned: 張福來 is a retired carpenter who built much of the furniture in town. He has been married to 張秀琴 for forty-five years and plays chess in Johnson Park every morning. He has known 陳建國 since 陳建國 was a boy.
currently: 張福來 wants to teach young people woodworking before he gets too old. He has started asking 陳建國 whether he could use the back of Harvey Oak Supply Store for a small weekend class.
lifestyle: 張福來 goes to bed around 9:30pm and wakes up around 5am.
